title: This Fungus Fires Its Spores at 20,000 Times Gravity

scenes.text: A fungus on animal dung fires spores like a cannon.
It builds up pressure inside, then the spore case shoots off.
The launch accelerates it at more than 20,000 times gravity.
It flies up to eight feet away.
Scaled up to a person, that's about 5,000 times the speed of sound.
A fungus that fires like a cannon. Yes, really.
